g1_arithmetic.conclusion: The required satellite excess return lies INSIDE the standard error of the underlying return difference estimated from 50 years of history. Expected-value driven satellite claims are therefore structurally undecidable with the available data.

hypotheses.H0: 100% global core remains the best non-falsified baseline.
hypotheses.H1: The satellite produces a material, robust portfolio effect that survives path, parameter and model uncertainty.
hypotheses.admissible_conclusion: No tested satellite delivers sufficiently robust incremental decision utility against a 100% global core.

indeterminate_claims.rationale: The required effect (0.83-2.48 pp/year satellite excess, depending on sleeve size) lies within the standard error of the underlying return difference (0.80-1.97 pp/year). A confirmatory run cannot decide this claim.
indeterminate_claims.reporting_rule: No statement about this asset's expected-return advantage may appear in any report. Reproducing the R0/D1-D4 rank ordering for it is ASSUMPTION_ECHO (G3), not evidence.

tested_claims.claim: A gold sleeve materially reduces portfolio downside against a 100% global equity core, WITHOUT any return assumption in gold's favour.

gates.model_gate: The advantage must not exist in only one model family.
gates.parameter_gate: A majority of parameter worlds must show the same advantage.

wealth_gate.and_is_mandatory: Without the AND, a candidate with a 60% hit rate and a median delta near zero would pass.
wealth_gate.materiality: median_delta >= 3.0% of the core median terminal value of the same cell

mu_neutrality.forbidden: Any gold mu assumption implying a return advantage.
mu_neutrality.rationale: G2: only second moments and tax/cost mechanics are decidable.

path_budget.rationale: SE(win rate) = 2.24pp at 500 paths vs 3.16pp at 250; the gate compares 60% against 50%.

tested_claims.required_model_robustness: While Engine A and Engine B are unavailable, the maximum attainable stage is MODEL_CONSISTENT_FINDING. No promotion.
